title: Funding Liquidity Interest Rate Timing Model: Which Indicators Predict Rates
tldr: A daily 11-factor voting model using funding liquidity indicators achieves superior interest rate timing and duration rotation, while monthly signals fail due to information loss.
abstract: This report builds a funding liquidity factor library of 12 categories and 74 indicators for interest rate timing. Using 20-day rolling window regression on the 7-10 year government bond net price index, 49 daily factors all generate positive excess returns, with NCD issuance rates and key-term bond yields performing best. A dynamic factor selection and equal-weight voting model with 11 factors yields the best cumulative return of 19.78%. Monthly-frequency timing fails due to signal lag and information loss. Applying the 11-factor daily signal to duration rotation between long-term bond and money market fund indices achieves 4.52% annualized return with -1.31% max drawdown, outperforming benchmarks.
strategy: The strategy uses funding liquidity factors as meso-level indicators between macro fundamentals and micro price-volume for interest rate timing. A long-only approach is adopted: hold the 7-10 year government bond net price index when bullish, stay in cash when bearish. For duration rotation, the 11-factor daily signal is applied: when bullish on bonds, hold the long-duration (7-10 year) government bond total wealth index; when bearish, switch to short-duration (1-3 year) wealth index or the money market fund index. [source: "看多债市时持有长久期财富指数，看空时持有短久期财富指数或货币基金指数"] Bilateral transaction costs of 2 basis points are set to reflect realistic conditions. [source: "我们设置了双边万分之二的交易成本"]
method: The methodology has three stages: (1) Factor library construction: 104 candidate indicators across 12 categories are collected. Sparse indicators (>10% missing) are removed; remaining indicators undergo forward-fill, lag adjustment by publication delay, and first-difference transformation. [source: "对各个因子序列进行前向填充以填补缺失值，并按其发布延迟时间进行滞后，在此基础上作一阶差分"] (2) Single-factor timing: A 20-day rolling window linear regression of factor differences on 7-10 year bond net price index returns generates daily signals. [source: "以20日为窗口，对于每个因子，构建单因子差分序列对7-10年净价指数涨跌幅序列的滚动回归模型"] (3) Multi-factor voting: Factors ranked by 20-day cumulative return; VIF-based selection (threshold=10) ensures independence; selected factors vote equally—bullish if long factors exceed short, otherwise maintain previous signal. [source: "当且仅当组合FST未满且fk加入FST后算得fk对FST中其他因子回归的VIF均不大于10时通过检验"]
experiment: Sample period: December 31, 2016 to March 5, 2026. Target: ChinaBond Government Bond Total Net Price (7-10 Year) Index (CBA00652.CB). Single-factor timing tests all 49 daily factors. Multi-factor timing tests dynamic factor counts of 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, and 19, with 11 factors identified as optimal. [source: "表现最好的因子组合是11个因子，其在回测区间内的累积收益率19.78%"] Monthly-frequency timing uses 20-month rolling regression with the same voting logic. Duration rotation is tested in two settings: (1) between 7-10Y and 1-3Y government bond wealth indices; (2) between the 7-10Y wealth index and the CSI Money Market Fund Index (H11025.CSI). Rotation backtest period: February 3, 2017 to March 5, 2026, with bilateral transaction costs of 0.02%. [source: "回测区间为2017年2月3日至2026年3月5日"]
result: For single-factor daily timing, all 49 factors beat the benchmark (1.21% annualized), with the 3M NCD issuance rate achieving the best cumulative return of 20.48% (1.97% annualized). [source: "49个日频资金面因子均获得正收益且跑赢基准"] The 11-factor daily multi-factor strategy achieves 19.78% cumulative return (1.92% annualized, -1.75% max drawdown) vs. 12.08% for the benchmark. [source: "11|19.78%|1.92%|0.0162|-1.75%|49.30%"] In long bond-money fund duration rotation, the strategy achieves 4.52% annualized return, -1.31% max drawdown, and 2.79 return/risk ratio, vs. 4.09% annualized and -4.44% max drawdown for buy-and-hold long bonds. [source: "久期轮动策略|50.19%|4.52%|0.0162|-1.31%|2.7901"] Monthly-frequency timing fails to outperform the benchmark across all factor counts.
